-- Insert day_3 (96h after day_0 sentAt)
INSERT INTO leadSequenceQueue (leadId, scheduledFor, channel, sequenceKey, touchKey, status, createdBy)
SELECT q0.leadId,
  DATE_ADD(q0.sentAt, INTERVAL 96 HOUR),
  'email', 'summer_camp_nurture', 'day_3_spots_filling', 'scheduled', 'system_backfill'
FROM leadSequenceQueue q0
WHERE q0.sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
  AND q0.touchKey = 'day_0_camp_overview'
  AND q0.status = 'sent'
  AND DATE(q0.sentAt) = '2026-06-09'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM leadSequenceQueue q3
    WHERE q3.leadId = q0.leadId
      AND q3.sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
      AND q3.touchKey = 'day_3_spots_filling'
  );
